app.title: Guard Console
app.subtitle: CareSentry Safety Gateway
app.safety_notice: Research tool. Not for clinical decision-making. Confirm all medical information with a licensed clinician or pharmacist.
app.local_only_notice: Local session only. Records stay in memory and clear after 30 minutes.

ask.title: Ask About a Clinical Record
ask.description: Ask a question about the record to get a safe, checked answer.
ask.record_placeholder: Paste patient notes or care records here...
ask.question_placeholder: Type your question about the record...

verdict.verified_summary: Checked against the record. No issues found.
verdict.verified_action: Safe to read. Always check care choices with your doctor.
verdict.annotated_summary: We added safety notes from the record to this answer.
verdict.annotated_action: Please read all notes before you use this advice.
verdict.withheld_title: WITHHELD — Not shown for your safety
verdict.withheld_summary: The answer named a drug that conflicts with an allergy in the record.
verdict.withheld_action: Do not follow this advice. Please consult your care team.
verdict.withheld_reveal_button: Show unverified text (not safe to follow)
verdict.withheld_unverified_warning: Warning: This text failed safety checks and is not safe to follow.
verdict.abstain_summary: We could not check this answer against the record.
verdict.abstain_action: Please check this question with your care team.

check.title: Record and Summary Check
check.description: Check a summary against the record without running an AI model.
check.summary_placeholder: Paste the summary you want to check against the record...
check.missing_description: Safety rules from the record that the summary did not mention.

settings.title: Gateway Settings and Status
settings.privacy_text: Records stay in local memory only. No data is sent to the cloud. Sessions clear after 30 minutes.
settings.session_cleared: All session data cleared from memory.

errors.empty_record: Please provide a clinical record first.
errors.empty_question: Please enter a question to ask.
errors.empty_summary: Please paste a summary to check.
errors.request_failed: Gateway request failed. Please check that the gateway service is running.
errors.non_utf8: The file contains non-UTF-8 text. Please upload a standard text file.
errors.file_too_large: The record file is too large. Maximum size is 2 MB.
